title: Delivery Driver Cost & Payout Tracker
description_html:
Track the cost of delivery drivers who are paid by the hour.

Levels

  1. Part 1: cost
    • add_driver(driver_id, hourly_rate)
    • record_delivery(driver_id, start_sec, end_sec)
    • get_total_cost() = Σ rate × (end − start) / 3600, rounded to 2 dp
  2. Part 2: payouts
    • pay_up_to(pay_time) marks every delivery that ended at or before pay_time as paid
    • get_total_cost_unpaid()
  3. Part 3: peak concurrency
    • get_max_simultaneous_drivers(...) returns the most deliveries in progress at the same moment (reports differ on whether it takes a time window)

Progressive round: each level unlocks after the previous one passes. Write level 1 so later levels extend it rather than rewrite it.

Source: Candidate-reported Rippling coding round (prep-site write-ups, 2025–26). Candidate-reported; exact wording varies between reports.
